description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
